code_review: Even length, injective full-square or fully unknown seed, valid permutation ranks, positive budgets and valid coordinate alphabet are checked. The initial state enters the global incumbent before proposals.

A component-column permutation co is restricted to equal height classes across all messages, so bs[row*K+co[column]] remains within the source geometry. The output rank ranks[co[column]] is the corresponding physical-column rank.
Pair swaps preserve both component height classes. Single-column swaps may change pair identities; the experiment does not enumerate arbitrary segmentations during this stage.
Whole-cell wildcard scoring drops surviving half-coordinate information. The exact-domain refinement is evaluated separately and its fresh control still misses source 102.
scope: No sustained optimizer was run; independent arithmetic and code inspection only. The original control matches all 225 known coordinates; the fresh control matches 224/225 and is not a complete recovery.
